title: Lugha katika Nyimbo (Theme 14: Matumizi ya pesa)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child places the nyimbo in its kind and occasion, explains its lugha with an example, and presents it with the audience taking part.

floor.prerequisite: Tells a riddle or a story with the formula.
floor.question: Kitendawili! - ?

representations: a recording or a performance of "Senti senti hujaza kibubu, tuweke akiba"
steps: Listen to or read the text.
Explain its lugha with an example.
contexts: an evening of stories at home

board.do: Senti senti hujaza kibubu, tuweke akiba

board.say: Hii ni nyimbo ya aina gani, na inatumika lini?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child presents a short piece with the class responding.

misconceptions.repair: Ni takriri na methali: husisitiza kuweka akiba kidogo kidogo
Lugha ya picha ina maana iliyofichika.
Eleza kazi ya kipengele: kinasisitiza, kinajenga picha, kinaburudisha.

checks.question: "senti senti hujaza kibubu" ni kipengele gani cha lugha?
Kipengele cha takriri na methali kina umuhimu gani?
